<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server/{issuerPath}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>

</MethodEndpoint>



Path-insertion form of RFC 8414. Only the path of the configured issuer is served; any other path returns 404. Issuer paths with several segments are served the same way.
